lessons.aspect-tense: ceb-only lesson (profile ceb.md §8 'add', §4.1 and §4.9): from Bisaya aspect (nag-, ni-, mo-, na, pa, wala pa, wala na, sukad) to English tense — one table from Bisaya forms to English choices, then the two rules Bisaya lacks (a time word does not replace the verb form; with no time word English still has to choose a tense). Placed after perfect via profile.json lessonOrder.after; linked to deck 10 «Istorya-istorya»; no ko-en counterpart. Verb forms are the largest counted error in both Visayan samples and the standing rule does not cover them.
